title: Harnessing Tumor-Specific Transcript Diversity Uncovers a Shared Neoantigen Reservoir for Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma.
snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is refractory to immunotherapy due to its immunologically cold microenvironment and the scarcity of mutation-derived neoantigens. Here, we introduce NeoAPP, a computational tool designed to systematically decode neoantigens arising from tumor-specific transcripts (TSTs) generated by transcriptional dysregulation. By i...
